subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Subscription Plans
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our subscription plans. Due to increased demand and improved services, we will be adjusting our pricing structure effective next month. We understand the importance of providing you with high-quality services at a fair price, and we believe these changes will benefit both you and our business. Please review the updated plans on our website and feel free to reach out if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for your continued support.
